head.title: miCode - Your Dedicated Software Development Partner

meta.name: description
meta.content: miCode is a software development agency that helps you build, launch, and grow your digital products. We're a team of developers, designers, and product experts who are passionate about building great software.

header.class: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#040316]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#282836]

div.class: container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 text-center relative

h1.class: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter text-white leading-tight

div.h1:
Building Custom Software That
Scales With You
div.p: We design, develop, and test reliable, user-focused applications for startups and enterprises. Each project is tailored to your goals - designed for stability, built for growth, and tuned for performance.

button.class: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap font-medium disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 shrink-0 [&_svg]:shrink-0 outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 aria-invalid:border-destructive hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 has-[>svg]:px-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#6949E7] to-[#8B5CF6] hover:from-[#5A3DD1] hover:to-[#7C3AED] text-white px-8 py-3 text-base border-0 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

div.class: text-left flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start space-x-20 mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5

h2.class: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white mb-4 text-left

div.p: Smart solutions for every stage of your product! We build and launch digital products that work beautifully and grow with your business. Whether you're starting from scratch or upgrading existing systems, our team delivers software that fits.

div.class: mt-16 grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 max-w-6xl mx-auto

img.class: w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300

div.p: We build custom tools and solutions to fit your specific workflows, requirements, and goals.

img.class: w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300

div.p: Cross-platform apps built with scalable and stable architecture, built for performance across devices.

img.class: w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300

div.p: Design that puts users first - we create user interfaces that are both beautiful and functional.

img.class: w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300

div.p: We test and verify every solution, checking browsers, devices, and use cases. Manual and automated testing ensure reliability, speed, and security.

div.class: container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 relative
text-left flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start space-x-20 mx-auto max-w-6xl px-5

h2.class: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white mb-4 text-left

p.class: text-lg text-gray-300 text-left max-w-2xl w-full mb-16

div.p: Not just developers. Product partners. We don’t just write code - we solve problems, reduce time to market, and keep your users in focus from day one. We’re a software development agency that believes great products come from sharp thinking, close collaboration, and clean code. Our mission is simple: to help companies launch better software, faster, smarter, and with users at the centre.

div.class: bg-[#282836]/30 backdrop-blur-sm p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#282836] hover:border-[#6949E7]/50 transition-all duration-300 text-left
inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#6949E7]/10 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4

div.p: We work in iterations and adapt quickly. You'll always know where things stand and can impact its direction.

div.class: bg-[#282836]/30 backdrop-blur-sm p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#282836] hover:border-[#6949E7]/50 transition-all duration-300 text-left
inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#6949E7]/10 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4

div.p: Work directly with experienced engineers and designers. No juniors, no gaps.

div.class: bg-[#282836]/30 backdrop-blur-sm p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#282836] hover:border-[#6949E7]/50 transition-all duration-300 text-left
inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#6949E7]/10 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4

div.p: Need to start early and scale over time? We can help you ship your first version fast and scale from there.

div.class: bg-[#282836]/30 backdrop-blur-sm p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#282836] hover:border-[#6949E7]/50 transition-all duration-300 text-left
inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-[#6949E7]/10 p-3 rounded-lg mb-4

div.p: We organize everything through feedback, questions, and regular check-ins. You always know where things stand.

div.class: absolute inset-0 bg-[url('/images/bg-form.svg')] bg-center bg-no-repeat opacity-10
container mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 relative

h2.class: text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold text-white leading-tight mb-4

div.p: Looking for a reliable partner to bring your vision to life? We'd love to hear from you — let's talk about a plan that fits.
